_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed. LIGHT ticks skip only scan+research: if resolve.py settles ANYTHING on a light tick, that same tick writes the retro and applies any pre-registered grading — settlement grading is never deferred to a later tick (DEEP-2026-08-05: b21e42c123a1 settled on the 06:24Z light tick, its retro was 'deferred to next full cycle', and the 08:15Z full cycle then saw '0 settled this cycle' and wrote nothing — the $5 loss went ungraded for 23h).
reason: 2026-08-05 ~13:30Z full cycle: priority per CYCLE.md mandate was integrating the unactioned operator-notes.md 2026-08-05 10:53Z item -- re-test Kalshi/Manifold/Metaculus reachability from this runner after the egress allowlist update. Result: api.elections.kalshi.com and api.manifold.markets now return 200 (were 403 before the allowlist change); metaculus still 403 site-side, unchanged. Added strategy/tools/kalshi.py and corrected playbook.md's cross-venue divergence note, which still said direct fetch didn't work. Also fixed a tool bug flagged in the 12:31Z LIGHT-tick log: quote.py 403'd via urllib on a token the identical curl request served fine (TLS-fingerprint block, not UA sniffing) -- quote.py now falls back to curl on urllib failure. Research: used the new Kalshi channel on the two clusters it actually covers -- July CPI-MoM ladder (KXCPI-26JUL) and July payrolls ladder (KXPAYROLLS-26JUL) -- both reconcile closely with Polymarket's own bracket prices (e.g. PM 'inflation >=0.1%' 0.67 vs Kalshi-implied 0.645; PM '50k-100k jobs' 0.375 vs Kalshi-implied 0.38), so this is validation of both venues' pricing, not an edge -- no bet. July unemployment-rate siblings sum to 1.081 (normal vig, no arb). Fenerbahce/Sturm Graz (kickoff 18:00Z): ran an internal-consistency check on the 17-way exact-score partition (sums to 0.9775, a thin apparent underround) but it isn't cleanly exploitable -- 18 legs at real spreads would eat the ~2.25% margin, and max_stake_per_event_usd ($10) forbids the position size anyway; moneyline already checked this morning, no new info. Pirates/Brewers O/U 7.5 (23:40Z) and EDward Gaming/Top Esports (17:00Z): WebSearch found no priced numeric odds for either, only narrative leans -- coverage precondition fails, skipped. No bets placed (0 settled, 0 placed, cash $953.11 unchanged); d2dd24206542 still open past end date. 8 full cycles ran in the last 24h (min_full_cycles_per_day=4, exceeded; counted from journal/cycles.log, timestamps >= 2026-08-04T13:30Z, excluding LIGHT-tick lines). Set next_full_cycle_after to 16:30Z (~3h): gives the Fenerbahce kickoff (18:00Z) and tonight's MLB lines (Pirates/Brewers 23:40Z) time to firm up into a retrievable numeric benchmark, the nearest genuine event boundary worth another look.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick, and a settling tick writes its retro immediately (see _comment). Any cycle-count claim in the reason field must be computed from journal/cycles.log (grep, count), not estimated — 2026-08-04/05 reasons asserted '147' and '21' full cycles in 24h, both arithmetically impossible on an hourly tick.
